Dock your iPhone. Unlock a desktop. ProDocktive extends your iPhone to any AirPlay or USB-C display — powering a full desktop experience using your phone's CPU and GPU. Your phone becomes the screen, the trackpad, the air mouse, and the hand tracker.

Hello Product Hunt! 😎 Super pumped to launch ProDocktive today! We wanted a better way to interact with external displays, so we built an app that turns your iPhone into the ultimate desktop-style controller. No extra hardware, no clunky workarounds—just a clean, intuitive interface that puts you in command. With ProDocktive, you get: A seamless, desktop-class navigation experience directly from your phone screen. A beautifully minimal interface designed to keep you focused. Instant compatibility with your existing external display setups. We built this for people who value speed, focus, and premium design. Let us know what you think in the comments—ask me anything! 👇
